lead: `Core\Uri::parse` refuses a stray `%`, so `normalized`'s malformed-escape branch is owed no case.
body: The module doc's "two references that both wrote the same stray `%` are still the same reference" reads as behaviour a `compareTo` case can pin, but `parse` throws on `http://h/50%`, so no program can build such a `Uri` and the branch is defensive against one built some other way. Check what `parse` admits before writing a row about what a normalizer keeps.
